specs.name: firstDuplicate_none_nodup
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Int) (h_precond : firstDuplicate_precond lst),
    firstDuplicate lst h_precond = none → List.Nodup lst

specs.name: firstDuplicate_some_count_gt_one
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Int) (x : Int) (h_precond : firstDuplicate_precond lst),
    firstDuplicate lst h_precond = some x → lst.count x = 1

specs.name: firstDuplicate_some_mem
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Int) (x : Int) (h_precond : firstDuplicate_precond lst),
    firstDuplicate lst h_precond = some x → x ∈ lst

specs.name: firstDuplicate_nodup_none
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Int) (h_precond : firstDuplicate_precond lst),
    List.Nodup lst → firstDuplicate lst h_precond = none

specs.name: firstDuplicate_none_iff_nodup
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Int) (h_precond : firstDuplicate_precond lst),
    firstDuplicate lst h_precond = none ↔ List.Nodup lst

specs.name: firstDuplicate_some_iff_not_nodup
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Int) (h_precond : firstDuplicate_precond lst),
    (∃ x, firstDuplicate lst h_precond = some x) ↔ ¬List.Nodup lst

specs.name: firstDuplicate_result_count
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Int) (h_precond : firstDuplicate_precond lst),
    ∀ x, firstDuplicate lst h_precond = some x → 2 = lst.count x

specs.name: firstDuplicate_minimal_second_occ
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Int) (h_precond : firstDuplicate_precond lst),
    ∀ x, firstDuplicate lst h_precond = some x →
    lst.all (fun y == (lst.count y = 1) ∧ (secondOccIdx lst x = secondOccIdx lst y))

specs.name: firstDuplicate_none_all_distinct
specs.stmt: i < lst.length) (hj : j < lst.length), i < j → lst.get ⟨i, hi⟩ ≠ lst.get ⟨j, hj⟩

specs.name: firstDuplicate_two_same
specs.stmt:
∀ (x : Int) (h_precond : firstDuplicate_precond [x, x]),
    firstDuplicate [x, x] h_precond = some x

specs.name: firstDuplicate_meets_postcond
specs.stmt:
∀ (lst : List Int) (h_precond : firstDuplicate_precond lst),
    firstDuplicate_postcond lst (firstDuplicate lst h_precond) h_precond

specs.name: firstDuplicate_none_iff_nodup
specs.stmt: List Int) (h : firstDuplicate_precond l) : firstDuplicate l h = none ↔ l.Nodup

specs.name: firstDuplicate_some_mem_duplicate
specs.stmt: theorem firstDuplicate_some_mem_duplicate (l : List Int) (h_precond : firstDuplicate_precond l) (v : Int) : firstDuplicate l h_precond = some v → 1 < l.count v

specs.name: firstDuplicate_some_iff
specs.stmt:
firstDuplicate l = some v ↔
    ∃ i j : Fin l.length, i.val < j.val ∧ l.get i = v ∧ l.get j = v ∧
    ∀ j' : Fin l.length, ∀ i' : Fin l.length, i'.val < j'.val → l.get j' = l.get i' →
      j.val ≤ j'.val
